key.name: panel-position
key.description: Which section of the top bar the indicator is placed in.

key.name: panel-index
key.description: Order within the chosen panel box. 0 is first, -1 is last, and lower negatives count back from the end.

key.name: show-icon
key.summary: Show the Codex icon in the panel
key.description: Hide it to leave only the percentages in the top bar.

key.name: show-five-hour
key.summary: Show the 5-hour window in the panel
key.description: The 5-hour usage window. Hiding both falls back to the icon alone.

key.name: show-weekly
key.summary: Show the weekly window in the panel
key.description: The 7-day usage window. Hiding both falls back to the icon alone.

key.name: show-credits
key.summary: Show credits remaining in the menu
key.description: Hide it if your plan does not use credits.

key.name: show-progress-bars
key.summary: Show progress bars in the menu
key.description: Draw a usage bar under each window in the popup.

key.name: use-24-hour-time
key.description: Render reset and update times as 19:50 rather than 7:50 PM.
